John McGinn scored a deflected goal for Scotland to take the lead against Haiti. (Getty Images: Craig Williamson)

Brazil and Morocco are forced to share the spoils in their blockbuster clash after Qatar salvaged a late draw against Switzerland in San Francisco.

Scotland then secured a 1-0 win over Haiti, their first victory at a World Cup since 1990, to go top of Group C.

Look back on how all the action unfolded in our live blog.

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 1:20pm

By David Hirst

Thanks for joining myself and Simon today for three big World Cup matches.

We're wrapping up this blog to focus on the Socceroos.

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 1:07pm

By David Hirst

Well, now for the main event.

The Socceroos face Türkiye in their opening World Cup game.

We have a whole new blog for the match for you to enjoy.

Key Event

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 1:03pm

By David Hirst

Scotland has hung on to beat Haiti 1-0 in their World Cup opener in Boston.

John McGinn's first half opener was enough for the Scots to become the first European team to win a game at the tournament thus far.

Haiti pressed hard for an equaliser in the closing minutes, with Frantzdy Pierrot sending a glancing header just wide.

The win for Scotland, their first at a World Cup since 1990, coupled with Brazil and Morocco's 1-1 draw earlier, means they go top of Group C and in pole position to qualify for the knockout phase.

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 12:55pm

By David Hirst

Scotland trying to shut up shop now.

Hard to see Haiti salvaging anything out of this game, but there's still time ... six minutes of stoppage time to play.

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 12:51pm

By David Hirst

Haiti almost get an equaliser!

Frantzdy Pierrot rises high but glances his header wide!

Scotland keeper Angus Gunn was stranded.

Scotland hanging on a little here.

Yassin Fortune comes on for Haiti for the last five minutes.

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 12:48pm

By David Hirst

Teenager Findlay Curtis replaced goalscorer McGinn and Kenny McLean comes on for striker Lawrence Shankland.

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 12:44pm

By David Hirst

Haiti have picked up the pace looking for a leveller.

Scotland defenders forced to make some desperate blocks.

Scotland are not home and hosed yet.

Ten minutes to go plus stoppages.

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 12:42pm

By David Hirst

Scotland make three changes.

Nathan Patterson on for Aaron Hickey

Lyndon Dykes on for Che Adams

Ryan Christie on for Ben Gannon-Doak

Haiti makes one more change

Lenny Joseph on for Wilson Isidor

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 12:38pm

By David Hirst

John McGinn should really have another goal.

It was a tricky angle but should have done better, dragging his shot wide.

Still only 1-0.

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 12:36pm

By David Hirst

It's not been the best game but Scotland fans seem to be enjoying themselves.

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 12:33pm

By David Hirst

Another chance to watch a Maccas ad as the players stop for a drinks break.

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 12:30pm

By David Hirst

Ben Gannon-Doak is having a good game for Scotland.

The Bournemouth player just had a tough season with injuries but is proving a real handful for the Haiti defence.

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 12:27pm

By David Hirst

First change in the match comes for Haiti.

Josue Casimir comes on for Louicius Deedson.

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 12:21pm

By David Hirst

Great cross whipped in by Andy Robertson but Lawrence Shankland can't quite reach it.

Scotland haven't created much but that was a fantastic cross by Robertson.

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 12:16pm

By David Hirst

It keeps breaking down any time Haiti get a chance to attack.

Bellegarde had a good chance to put a ball through into the box put played it straight out for a goal kick.

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 12:12pm

By David Hirst

Scotland's Aaron Hickey gets a yellow card pretty much straight from kick-off for a foul.

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 12:10pm

By David Hirst

Doesn't look like there have been any half-time substitutions.

Can Scotland hold on or can Haiti find a way back into the game?

Let's go!

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 12:01pm

By David Hirst

John McGinn is now Scotland's fifth all-time top scorer. Not bad for a midfielder!

He's only nine goals behind legends like Denis Law and Kenny Dalglish.

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 11:56am

By David Hirst

I think a few pints would have been spilt when that McGinn goal went in. Will the Scotland fans still be celebrating after 90 minutes?

Sun 14 Jun 2026 at 11:53am

By David Hirst

Scotland go into the break with a slender lead.

They've been the better team but Haiti are not out of this.

A bit more quality up front and Haiti could have had a goal.
